description: US hazardous materials table (49 CFR 172.101, eCFR): UN number, proper shipping name, hazard class, packing group, labels, special provisions, for a UN number (e.g. 1203) or a name fragment (e.g. gasoline). It is the US DOT table, which follows the UN Model Regulations but is not the UN list itself. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

q.description: 4-digit UN number (1203) or a name fragment of 3 to 60 characters
